_comment: The dig run (#324): ore veins cut with the welder. Every number is a starting value, TODO(initiator). cut_s: seconds of holding the cut on one spot until a chunk comes off. cool_per_s: heat (0..1) lost per second when the cut is let go. chunks: chunks a full vein holds. regrow_s: seconds an empty vein takes to be full again. reach_m: how far the welder reaches (m). veins: ore item id and the spot, in metres from the dig site's centre (x east, y north). pocket (#333): the fizz pockets found with the sniffer; pockets: hidden pockets at a time; min_gap_m: least distance between two pockets (m); range_m: the sniffer hears this far (m); core_m: the signal's near scale (m), half of full at this distance; tap_radius_m and tap_s: how close and how long the tap is held to open one; jars: jars one pocket gives; open_s: seconds an open vent puffs; reach_m: how far an open vent reaches for a jar (m); field_half_m: half size of the search field around the dig site (m); margin_m: pockets keep this far off buildings, zones and the field's edge (m).
